4.name: Military Dominance
4.helpText:
This card is worth 2 fame [vp] for each production of [sword] you have in your kingdom. If a card has variable production, so that it produces either 1 [money] OR 1 [sword], it still counts as 1 [sword] production. Note that only resource icons on cards that are used for production are counted as production, not other effects that let you gain resources.
NOTE: Goals have the yellow name banner, just like persons. However, this is NOT a person.

description: This is a goal card. It is a permanent card which will be worth fame depending on how well you do in a certain metric. The red arrows at the top of this card means that when you discover it, you must choose which of its 2 sides should be face up (the serial number must be at the top of this card, whichever side you choose). Choose wisely, since you cannot change this later.
